title: 目標達成の後に・春雷を目指して

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finally strengthened her body up enough, Tamamo Cross is ecstatic when I give her the green light to take on the senior G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross's roommate and close friend, is making steady progress in her classic year…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And her running has an inexplicable hold on Tamamo Cross's attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to put up a good fight against her, Tamamo Cross heads for the Hanshin Daishoten. This race will make for the perfect stepping stone to her father's beloved race, the spring Tenno Sho.
